author: Nancy R. Buchan

steps.title: Define sample size and quotas
steps.instruction: Target 200 adult participants in each of the six countries (US, Italy, Russia, Argentina, South Africa, Iran), distributed equally across 18 demographic categories created by crossing three age groups [18‑35], [36‑55], [56‑75], two gender groups, and three socioeconomic status levels (low, medium, high). For Iran, recruit only from the largest and fifth‑largest cities; for South Africa, recruit from four districts of Johannesburg.

steps.title: Recruit participants
steps.instruction: Commission polling companies to recruit participants in Italy, Russia, and Argentina; use advertisements in the US and South Africa; rely partly on word‑of‑mouth recruitment in Iran due to security concerns.

steps.title: Convene participants in venues
steps.instruction: Gather participants at research venues in groups of 10 to 20. A native‑speaker facilitator conducts each session with assistance from local staff.

steps.title: Assign IDs and explain decisions
steps.instruction: Assign each participant a numeric research ID and explain the three experimental decision tasks.

steps.title: Conduct comprehension check
steps.instruction: Administer a comprehension check; only participants who pass may proceed to the decision tasks.

steps.title: Collect token decisions privately
steps.instruction: Participants place paper tokens representing money into different envelopes that have the session ID printed on them, ensuring privacy of each decision.

steps.title: Administer questionnaire
steps.instruction: Have participants fill out the questionnaire privately; assistants read questions aloud to illiterate participants.

steps.title: Enter decisions into electronic sheets
steps.instruction: Assistants collect the decision envelopes and enter each participant’s choices into electronic worksheets.

steps.title: Match decisions and calculate payoffs
steps.instruction: Run an electronic algorithm that matches each participant’s decision with those of other participants and determines individual payoffs.

steps.title: Distribute payoff envelopes
steps.instruction: Assistants place each participant’s payoff amount into an envelope printed with that participant’s ID and give the envelope to the participant after the questionnaire is completed; no payoff or decision is ever linked to personal identity.
